scripts.preinstall: sh -c 'rm -f package-lock.json yarn.lock; case "$npm_config_user_agent" in pnpm/*) ;; *) echo "Use pnpm instead" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac'
scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.test:quote-browser: node scripts/ensure-playwright-chromium.mjs && playwright test e2e/live-quote.spec.ts e2e/admin-authorization.spec.ts e2e/admin-overview.spec.ts e2e/admin-orders.spec.ts e2e/admin-integrations.spec.ts e2e/admin-currencies.spec.ts e2e/admin-pricing.spec.ts e2e/customer-account.spec.ts e2e/responsive-layout.spec.ts e2e/affiliate.spec.ts e2e/landing-background.spec.ts
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
